cleaned_body_text: REFORM OF THE RESOURCE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM A Pathway to Reform Working Paper 2: A model for the future Greg Severinsen First published October 2019 Published by: Environmental Defence Society Incorporated P O Box 91736 Victoria St West Auckland 1142 Phone (09) 302 2972 manager@eds.org.nz www.eds.org.nz www.environmentguide.org.nz © Environmental Defence Society Incorporated 2019 Design: Neale Wills, Wilsy Design & Production Ltd Photographic images: Raewyn Peart Cover Image: Shutterstock Copies can be downloaded from www.eds.org.nz ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS The Environmental Defence Society would like to give special thanks to the primary funders of this project, the New Zealand Law Foundation and the Michael and Suzanne Borrin Foundation. Thanks also to the Property Council New Zealand, Infrastructure New Zealand, and the Employers and Manufacturers Association (Northern) for providing financial support for the project. In addition, we would like to thank all the people who have contributed to the project so far, including members of our Advisory Group, interviewees at home and abroad, and those who attended our series of workshops in August and September 2019. Special thanks go to Raewyn Peart, who contributed to the paper prior to her appointment to the government’s review group on resource management system reform, and to Aidan Cameron and Olivia Grainger for their valuable input.
